author: Widogeist
body:
Assassin jewels (weapon adornment) can cause t.def-- debuff, heretic jewels (also weapon adornments) can cause t.res-- debuff. With weapon adornments, having multiple of the same adornment increases the chance of the debuff triggering; [here](https://i.imgur.com/c35Qef2.png) is a chart that displays trigger chance based on amount of adornments.

Pets/followers that use the skill [wallop](https://codex.fqegg.top/#/codex/spells/wallop/) will cause both t.def-- and t.res-- debuff whenever they use the skill. Since you're currently T8, the only followers available to you with the Wallop skill would be T6 Scary Skeleton, T7 Melon, T8 Pumpkinhead, T8 Beaver - they are all event exclusive pets, so unless you purchased them during their respective events then you likely don't have them.
